name: aleph-zero
description: Local code search for coding agents: ranked code locations by meaning or by name, always matching the working tree, and steering that makes Claude Code use it before recursive grep

rung.title: Steering rung
rung.description: How far the plugin steers Claude Code towards Aleph's search. 0: the tools only. 1 (default): the search tools loaded up front, a short instruction to search before a recursive grep, a pointer in Grep's and Glob's descriptions, and the same instruction after each subagent's task. 2: also ranked locations with the first question of a session and with each subagent's task. 3: also ranked locations after a Grep tool search or a recursive grep that found nothing.

grep_pointer.title: Pointer in Grep and Glob
grep_pointer.description: on or off (default on): whether the descriptions of Grep and Glob point to Aleph's search (part of rung 1).

lines.title: Rung 2's lines
lines.description: places or signatures (default places): what rung 2 shows for each file, its places only, or also the signature of its first result.

graph.title: Call graph, facts and decision tools
graph.description: on or off (default on; nothing to activate). On: when a prompt or a grep names an HTTP route or an environment variable, or a prompt's words point to a route, where the code handles or reads it is given to the agent; the facts tool is shown in full, the call-graph and decision-record tools on demand. Measured (2026-10-16): the agent called facts and read the right file first in 26 of 30 route questions (24 with it off), at the same tokens. Needs the engine's tools allowed (aleph-zero setup --allow-tools).

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: on or off (default on): whether each subagent's task gets the instruction to locate code with Aleph's search before a recursive grep (rung 1) and the ranked locations for the task (rung 2). Forks, resumed runs and workflow agents are left alone. Not measured yet.

grep_assist.title: Rung 3's greps
grep_assist.description: empty or first (default empty): rung 3 adds ranked locations after a grep that found nothing, or also beside the first locating grep of each turn and each subagent. Not measured yet.

allow_reads.title: Allow the read-only tools
allow_reads.description: on or off (default on): the plugin allows Aleph's read-only tools (search, symbol, outline, status, facts, references, decisions, recall) itself, so neither the agent nor its own look-ups wait on a permission dialog. A deny rule in your settings still stands; remember, which writes, is still asked.
